subject.title: fix(reef): bound JSONL store file reads to prevent OOM on oversized audit/replay stores

question: What durable recovery contract should Reef use when its replay ledger exceeds the bounded-read limit?
rationale: The safe availability tradeoff is product behavior: silently accepting a partial replay ledger weakens replay protection, while fail-closed behavior requires an operator recovery path for an already oversized store.

options.title: Fail closed for replay ledgers
options.body: Keep prefix reads for audit history, but make replay-ledger loading return a bounded, actionable error so no receipt record is silently ignored.

options.title: Approve a durable recovery path
options.body: Define and implement compaction or migration that preserves complete replay semantics before allowing an oversized ledger to serve claims.

recommendation.title: Fail closed for replay ledgers
recommendation.body: Keep prefix reads for audit history, but make replay-ledger loading return a bounded, actionable error so no receipt record is silently ignored.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor has the most direct context on the proposed audit/replay reader split, although current-main ownership should be confirmed by a repository owner.
